name: CR2325

dimensions.note: Panasonic BR2325 datasheet publishes maximum dimensions only; nominal is set to the maximum. The CR2325 size code gives the same values.

variants.notes: No CR2325 datasheet was located, so capacity and weight are not published here.

variants.label: BR2325

capacity_mah.conditions: Panasonic nominal capacity at 0.03 mA continuous standard drain; cutoff not stated

variants.notes: BR2325 is a lithium-carbon-monofluoride cell in the same case. It has a flatter discharge curve and lower pulse capability than the CR type, and lower rated drain.

interchange.note: Same 23 mm diameter and 0.5 mm thinner; lower capacity and may make poor contact in a CR2325 holder.
Same 23 mm diameter and 0.5 mm thicker; fits only where the holder has the clearance.

sources.title: BR2325 BR Coin-type Lithium Battery datasheet
Button batteries and other swallowed batteries

safety: Swallowed coin cells can cause severe internal burns within two hours. Keep batteries away from children, and seek emergency medical care immediately if one is swallowed or placed in the nose or ears.
In the United States, the National Battery Ingestion Hotline is 1-800-498-8666 and Poison Help is 1-800-222-1222.
Do not recharge, crush, puncture, heat or short-circuit a primary lithium coin cell.
